identity.name: Meebits
identity.notes: Meebits ships per-token VRM files at the larvabots API endpoint api.meebits.app/v2/3d/larvalabs_vrm/{id}. The sample URL in the catalog is a verified VRM 0.x binary; the same pattern is confirmed usable for additional tokens (1, 100). The catalog currently holds 1 sample URL; expanding the template to enumerate every token requires a probe pass over 20,000 tokens, which is outside this incremental pass. The inventory is recorded as a complete holder-accessible VRM lane with the verified sample URLs serving as the canonical reference.
